denial.reason_text: Claim received after the filing deadline.

checklist: Locate proof of timely filing (clearinghouse acceptance report).
Appeal only with that proof attached; otherwise the claim is not recoverable.

deadline.basis: Plan reconsideration: 60 calendar days after receipt of the organization determination; receipt is presumed 5 days after the notice date. Enrollee appeal window. Contracted providers' payment disputes with a Medicare Advantage plan follow the provider contract; check the denial notice.
